Talent gracefully adorns life; but it is Will which carries us victoriously through the struggle. Intellect is the torch which lights us on our way; Will, the strong arm which rough hews the path for us.

arxiv-2303-08235.title: Adaptive Planning and Control with Time-Varying Tire Models for Autonomous Racing Using Extreme Learning Machine
arxiv-2303-08235.creator: Dvij Kalaria, Qin Lin, John M. Dolan
arxiv-2303-08235.description: Abstract Autonomous racing is a challenging problem, as the vehicle needs to operate at the friction or handling limits in order to achieve minimum lap times. Autonomous race cars require highly accurate perception, state estimation, planning and precise application of controls.

arxiv-2403-14996.title: What we can learn about compact binary mergers from their kilonova signals?
arxiv-2403-14996.creator: Agnieszka Janiuk, Joseph Saji, Gerardo Urrutia
arxiv-2403-14996.description: Abstract Compact binary mergers are sources of gravitational waves, and can be accompanied by electromagnetic signals. We discuss the possible features in the kilonova emissions which may help distinguish the black hole - neutron star mergers from the binary neutron stars.

arxiv-2405-01578.title: Empowering IoT Applications with Flexible, Energy-Efficient Remote Management of Low-Power Edge Devices
arxiv-2405-01578.creator: 1 st Shadi Attarha, 2 nd Anna Förster
arxiv-2405-01578.description: Abstract In the context of the Internet of Things (IoT), reliable and energy-efficient provision of IoT applications has become critical. Equipping IoT systems with tools that enable a flexible, well-performing, and automated way of monitoring and managing IoT edge devices is an essential prerequisite.

arxiv-2406-05120.title: Contextual fusion enhances robustness to image blurring
arxiv-2406-05120.creator: Shruti Joshi, Aiswarya Akumalla, Seth Haney, Maxim Bazhenov
arxiv-2406-05120.description: Abstract Mammalian brains handle complex reasoning by integrating information across brain regions specialized for particular sensory modalities. This enables improved robustness and generalization versus deep neural networks, which typically process one modality and are vulnerable to perturbations. While defense methods exist, they do not generalize well across perturbations.

arxiv-2409-17483.title: Heterogeneous Hyper-Graph Neural Networks for Context-aware Human Activity Recognition
arxiv-2409-17483.creator: Wen Ge § , Guanyi Mou § , Emmanuel O. Agu, Kyumin Lee
arxiv-2409-17483.description: Abstract Context-aware Human Activity Recognition (CHAR) is challenging due to the need to recognize the user’s current activity from signals that vary significantly with contextual factors such as phone placements and the varied styles with which different users perform the same activity.

arxiv-2503-06253.title: MAD-MAX: Modular And Diverse Malicious Attack MiXtures for Automated LLM Red Teaming
arxiv-2503-06253.creator: Stefan Schoepf, Muhammad Zaid Hameed, Ambrish Rawat, Kieran Fraser, Giulio Zizzo, Giandomenico Cornacchia, Mark Purcell
arxiv-2503-06253.description: Abstract With LLM usage rapidly increasing, their vulnerability to jailbreaks that create harmful outputs are a major security risk. As new jailbreaking strategies emerge and models are changed by fine-tuning, continuous testing for security vulnerabilities is necessary. Existing Red Teaming methods fall short in cost efficiency, attack success rate, attack diversity, or extensibility as new attack types emerge.

arxiv-2504-13205.title: On-Device Watermarking: A Socio-Technical Imperative for Authenticity in the Age of Generative AI
arxiv-2504-13205.creator: Houssam Kherraz
arxiv-2504-13205.description: Abstract As generative AI models produce increasingly realistic output, both academia and industry are focusing on the ability to detect whether an output was generated by an AI model or not. Many of the research efforts and policy discourse are centered around robust watermarking of AI outputs.

arxiv-2507-11529.title: Dam breaks in the discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation
arxiv-2507-11529.creator: Shrohan Mohapatra, Su Yang, Sathyanarayanan Chandramouli, P. G. Kevrekidis
arxiv-2507-11529.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shrohan Mohapatra, Su Yang, Sathyanarayanan Chandramouli, P. G. Kevrekidis. In the present work we study the nucleation of Dispersive shock waves (DSW) in the defocusing, discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation (DNLS), a model of wide relevance to nonlinear optics and atomic condensates. Here, we study the dynamics of so-called dam break problems with step-initial data characterized by two-parameters, one of which corresponds to the lattice spacing, while the other being the right hydrodynamic background.

pmc-10518659.title: TPN-COF@Fe-MIL-100 composite used as an electrochemical aptasensor for detection of trace tetracycline residues†
pmc-10518659.creator: Yubo Meng, Yuchun Huang, Gailing Huang, Yingpan Song
pmc-10518659.description: In this work, a metal–organic framework@covalent organic framework composite (TPN-COF@Fe-MIL-100) was prepared and used as a sensing material to construct an aptasensor for trace detection of tetracycline (TET). The TPN-COF@Fe-MIL-100 integrates a large surface area, porous structure, excellent electrochemical activity, rich chemical functionality, and strong bioaffinity for aptamers, providing abundant active sites to effectively anchor aptamer strands.
